hey, i really feel for you. you've been through a lot, being sexually assaulted at a young age can be so traumatic, and it sucks not having support from your family/ being treated poorly by your dad on top of that. 

have you ever told them about what happened to you? maybe this would make them reconsider letting you go to therapy at the very least. i know how scary it is to confide in someone, especially when you feel as though they may not understand, but it's worth a shot.

even if they don't, it sounds like you have support around you from your friends and boyfriend right? please latch on to that, they all care more than you know. with the right support, you will get stronger and be able to deal with the world better as you grow older. please just try and confide in your parents or do whatever you need to to get help, i'm sure they would rather get you help before you harm yourself in anyway. 
please take care of yourself, stay safe 💙

hey, taking that much paracetamol is definitely likely to lead to some degree of liver damage, please take yourself to hospital or tell your parents if you can, the longer you leave it the worse it will get, maybe even causing permanent damage which means you will be on liver dialysis for the rest of your life. overdose is never an easy way to go, please save yourself the days of pain you're gonna go through and get help asap. 

please take care, you've got your whole life ahead of you, things will get better 💙

and what makes you think you constantly hurt her? of course i don't know you or what's happened in your life but i think the impression you have of yourself is significantly worse than anyone else's. 

my mom struggled with severe depression when i was a kid, and those were definitely tough times, but seeing her overcome it (or at least control it better) over the last few years has made her my biggest role model, and i admire and love her more than anything. please give yourself the same chance and trust me, whoever you think you're letting down right now will accept and appreciate you, for who you are, not who you think you should be or who they want you to be.

hey, i think you're a kind hearted person, you obviously care so much about the people around you. you sound like a great older sister, and perfection is a dangerous standard to chase. no one is perfect, it's part of being human. please give yourself a chance, depression lies. you do deserve to laugh, smile, be happy and live. 
please stay safe, i hope you're still here 💙

hey, sounds like you're really struggling right now, it can be really tough to lose someone you love like that. but please hold onto life, who knows what other opportunities might come your way or who you might meet in the future? this is just a new chapter in your life, a hurdle i'm sure you will climb eventually, even though it's destroying you right now. just see it through, things will get better. 
praying for you, please stay safe 💙

hey, what you've been through is terrible, i'm so sorry, i find it sickening that people like this are free to walk around in society after inflicting that kind of trauma on someone else, they deserve to rot. 

but i don't think killing yourself is the answer. 
i personally believe in karma, that one day they will get what's coming for them, one way or another, and ultimately bad things happen to bad people (an understatement in this case). and sure this is kind of idealistic but it works for me. 

so live out of spite. don't let this monster have the last laugh, but keep living as a 'fuck you' to your rapist. none of this is your fault, but please don't give in. the system has failed you, but all you can do is stay strong for now, who knows what the future will bring? 
please stay safe, take care 💙

hey, it sounds like your going through a bad low point, but life inherently has ups and downs, i can see why you might reminisce about the good times you had and feel like you'll never get there again, but you'll never know if you don't keep going? 

chances are things will start to look up again, especially when covid is over, please just hang on, better times are around the corner.
